mapper.insert: MERGE INTO visit_log target USING ( SELECT #{memberNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS member_no, #{sessionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS session_id, #{requestUri, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS request_uri, #{queryString, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS query_string, #{requestMethod, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS request_method, #{userAgent, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS user_agent, #{ipAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS ip_address, #{referer, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS referer, SYSTIMESTAMP AS visited_date FROM dual ) source ON ( target.ip_address = source.ip_address AND TRUNC(CAST(target.created_date AS DATE)) = TRUNC(CAST(source.visited_date AS DATE)) ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.member_no = NVL(target.member_no, source.member_no), target.session_id = source.session_id, target.request_uri = source.request_uri, target.query_string = source.query_string, target.request_method = source.request_method, target.user_agent = source.user_agent, target.referer = source.referer, target.last_visit_date = source.visited_date, target.daily_request_count = NVL(target.daily_request_count, 1) + 1 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( member_no, session_id, request_uri, query_string, request_method, user_agent, ip_address, referer, created_date, last_visit_date, daily_request_count ) VALUES ( source.member_no, source.session_id, source.request_uri, source.query_string, source.request_method, source.user_agent, source.ip_address, source.referer, source.visited_date, source.visited_date, 1 )
mapper.update: MERGE INTO visit_daily_stat target USING ( SELECT TRUNC(CAST(v.created_date AS DATE)) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS unique_visitor_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.member_no IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS member_visitor_count, SUM(CASE WHEN v.member_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS guest_visitor_count, SUM(NVL(v.daily_request_count, 1)) AS request_count FROM visit_log v WHERE v.created_date < TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member admin_member WHERE admin_member.no = v.member_no AND admin_member.role = 'ADMIN' ) GROUP BY TRUNC(CAST(v.created_date AS DATE)) ) source ON (target.stat_date = source.stat_date) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.unique_visitor_count = source.unique_visitor_count, target.member_visitor_count = source.member_visitor_count, target.guest_visitor_count = source.guest_visitor_count, target.request_count = source.request_count, target.updated_date = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( stat_date, unique_visitor_count, member_visitor_count, guest_visitor_count, request_count, created_date, updated_date ) VALUES ( source.stat_date, source.unique_visitor_count, source.member_visitor_count, source.guest_visitor_count, source.request_count, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM visit_log WHERE created_date < TRUNC(SYSDATE) - #{retentionDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
